Treatment with interferon alfa plus ribavirin appears promising.26-28 Nephrotoxicity from ciclosporin or tacrolimus can be a significant problem after long-term therapy.29 Long-term renal function is affected by the function in the early post- transplant period, so serum creatinine concentrations at 1 and 3 months are often used to predict toxicity.7 Cardio- vascular complications may follow metabolic abnormali- ties such as diabetes mellitus, hypertension, hyperlipidae- mia, and obesity. Dose reduction or change of the calcineurin inhibitor used, corticosteroid withdrawal, or use of statins could minimise the cardiovascular risk post- transplantation.30-32 Malignancy may occur after pro- longed immunosuppression.4,20,23 1.
